Computes the reflection and token fee amounts for a transfer.

Computes reflection-denominated amounts from token amounts and the current rate.
Returns the reflection-to-token rate from current supplies.

Owner-only setter for _liquidityFee constrained to 1-49.

edges.reason: constructor reads _rTotal to mint the initial reflection balance
constructor assigns the immutable uniswapV2Pair created by the factory
constructor exempts owner, contract, marketing and dead wallet from fees
constructor blacklists known sniper bot addresses
constructor reads _marketingWalletAddress to exempt it from fees
constructor reads _DeadWalletAddress to exempt it from fees
Ownable constructor stores the deployer in _owner
constructor calls owner() to build the exemption list
constructor emits a Transfer event describing _tTotal supply
msg.sender becomes the initial owner and holder of the reflection supply
msg.sender determines the sender of a transfer
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping
msg.sender is the spender and allowance owner in transferFrom
spender is the destination key written by _approve
_transfer enforces _maxTxAmount for non-owner and non-pair senders
_transfer checks the sender against uniswapV2Pair to avoid circular swaps
_transfer checks the inSwapAndLiquify lock before swapping
caller-controlled addresses flow into the sender/recipient handling of _transfer
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee-free transfer
takeFee parameter selects the fee handling of _tokenTransfer
swapAndLiquify reads _marketingFee for the split ratio
swapAndLiquify reads _liquidityFee for the split ratio
lockTheSwap sets and clears inSwapAndLiquify around swapAndLiquify
contractTokenBalance parameter is split inside swapAndLiquify
toMarketing = balance*marketingFee/(marketingFee+liquidityFee) with truncating division and no slippage protection
initialBalance snapshot of contract ETH is taken inside swapAndLiquify
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call
tokenAmount parameter is the amount swapped by swapTokensForEth
addLiquidity mints LP tokens to owner()
addLiquidity performs the external addLiquidityETH value call
tokenAmount parameter is added as liquidity
sendETHToMarketing performs the ETH transfer interaction
manualSwap reads the contract token balance via balanceOf
onlyOwner modifier gates manualSwap on msg.sender
manualSend forwards the entire ETH balance to the dead/marketing wallet
onlyOwner modifier gates manualSend on msg.sender
onlyOwner modifier gates setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled on msg.sender
onlyOwner modifier gates setExcludeFromFee on msg.sender
account parameter is the exclusion target
onlyOwner modifier gates excludeFromReward on msg.sender
includeInReward mutates and pops the _excluded array
account parameter is the inclusion target
onlyOwner modifier gates includeInReward on msg.sender
account parameter is the blacklist target
onlyOwner modifier gates addBotToBlackList on msg.sender
account parameter is the removal target
onlyOwner modifier gates removeBotFromBlackList on msg.sender
deliver treats msg.sender as the reflection donor
deliver requires the sender not to be excluded from reward
recoverTokens calls _transfer to move tokens to the owner
recoverTokens performs an owner-only token sweep of the contract balance
onlyOwner modifier gates recoverTokens on msg.sender
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender
onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership on msg.sender
balanceOf indirectly calls _getRate through the reflection conversion
_getTValues computes tAmount*taxFee/100 and tAmount-tFee-marketingLiquidityFee with truncating division and unchecked ordering assumptions
local currentRate is produced by _getRate as rSupply/tSupply
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making the call depend on miner-controlled time
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidity deadline, making the call depend on miner-controlled time
the external router swap can re-enter the contract before swapAndLiquify finishes; lockTheSwap only blocks a second swap
ETH returned by the router swap enters the payable receive() hook during swapAndLiquify execution
addLiquidityETH forwards ETH to the router/pair, an external value call that can re-enter the contract
the ETH transfer to the dead/marketing wallet is an external interaction performed after swaps inside the locked region

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only an alias for the recipient argument consumed by the core _transfer routine.
amount is only an alias for the amount argument validated and forwarded by _transfer.
sender is only an alias for the sender argument validated by _transfer.
tAmount is the input amount consumed by the core accounting function _getValues and its helpers.
contractTokenBalance is the token quantity processed by the core swapAndLiquify operation.
tokenAmount is the quantity approved and swapped by the core swapTokensForEth routine.
takeFee only selects the fee branch handled by the core _tokenTransfer routine.
account is the target address mutated by the reward-exclusion and blacklist management logic.
spender is the allowance key written by the core _approve routine.
the local contractTokenBalance is derived and clamped inside the core _transfer routine.
the local takeFee flag is computed and consumed only inside the core _transfer routine.
currentRate is the reflection rate produced by the core _getRate routine and reused by conversions.
toMarketing is the marketing share computed and spent inside the core swapAndLiquify routine.
initialBalance is the ETH snapshot used to measure swap proceeds inside the core swapAndLiquify routine.
